answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent burns 300 POA for one slot, assigned at random by a beacon so no one can pick a corner. A slot is like a tree in an orchard: it pays only when tended with work, and an idle slot loses its deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 300 = 300,000 POA, while one honest agent pays once and keeps earning. An identity that trades with no one sits like an island and earns nothing, so honest work beats faking it.
